readme.excerpt: # pdfplumber [![Version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/pdfplumber.svg)](https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pdfplumber) ![Tests](https://github.com/jsvine/pdfplumber/workflows/Tests/badge.svg) [![Code coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/jsvine/pdfplumber/branch/stable/graph/badge.svg)](https://codecov.io/gh/jsvine/pdfplumber/branch/stable) [![Support Python versions](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/pdfplumber.svg)](https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pdfplumber) Plumb a PDF for detailed information about each text character, rectangle, and line. Plus: Table extraction and visual debugging. Works best on machine-generated, rather than scanned, PDFs. Built on [`pdfminer.six`](https://github.com/goulu/pdfminer). Currently [tested](tests/) on [Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14](.github/workflows/tests.yml). Translations of this document are available in: [Chinese (by @hbh112233abc)](https://github.com/hbh112233abc/pdfplumber/blob/stable/README-CN.md). __To report a bug__ or request a feature, please [file an issue](https://github.com/jsvine/pdfplumber/issues/new/choose). __To ask a question__ or request assistance with a specific PDF, please [use the discussions forum](https://github.com/jsvine/pdfplumber/discussions). ## Table of Contents - [Installation](#installation) - [Command line interface](#command-line-interface) - [Python library](#python-library) - [Visual debugging](#visual-debugging) - [Extracting text](#extracting-text) - [Extracting tables](#extracting-tables) - [Extracting form values](#extracting-form-values) - [Demonstrations](#demonstrations) - [Comparison to other libraries](#comparison-to-other-libraries) -

bank/bank_best.jsonl.summary: Extract text, tables, and detailed layout info from PDFs

bank/bank_liftable_ranked.jsonl.description: Plumb a PDF for detailed information about each char, rectangle, line, et cetera — and easily extract text and tables.

bank/bank_contractcard.jsonl.one_liner: Extracts text, tables, and detailed char/line/rect geometry from PDFs, built on pdfminer.six.
bank/bank_contractcard.jsonl.provides: ["pdfplumber.open(path) -> PDF; page.extract_text() / extract_words()", "page.extract_table()/extract_tables() with configurable table strategies", "Per-object access: page.chars/lines/rects/curves/images with bbox geometry", "Visual debugging: page.to_image() for cropping/inspection", "Geometry utilities (bbox/clustering/edges) in pdfplumber.utils", "repair() to fix malformed PDFs"]
bank/bank_contractcard.jsonl.requires: ["(manifest-enforced) PyPI 'pdfplumber'; hard dep pdfminer.six (text extraction engine) + Pillow (images)", "(readme-asserted) to_image()/visual debugging needs an ImageMagick/Ghostscript-backed image stack", "(readme-asserted) Python 3 (no requires_python pinned in the shown manifests)"]
bank/bank_contractcard.jsonl.assumptions: ["text-based PDFs (no OCR; scanned images yield no text)", "pdfminer.six installed automatically as a dependency", "optional image tooling present for to_image()"]
bank/bank_contractcard.jsonl.recipe: {"install": "pip install pdfplumber", "wire": ["import pdfplumber", "with pdfplumber.open('doc.pdf') as pdf:", "    page = pdf.pages[0]; text = page.extract_text(); tables = page.extract_tables()"]}
bank/bank_contractcard.jsonl.surface: medium - PDF/page objects + extraction + geometry utils
bank/bank_contractcard.jsonl.semantics: [{"gotcha": "raises MalformedPDFException / PdfminerException (utils/exceptions.py) on corrupt PDFs - wrap open()/extraction; try repair() first", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "NO OCR: scanned/image-only PDFs return empty text - you need a separate OCR step for those", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "table extraction is heuristic; lines-vs-text strategy choice dramatically changes results - tune table_settings", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}, {"gotcha": "to_image() pulls an extra image stack (Pillow + ghostscript/ImageMagick); absent it, visual debugging fails", "kind": "hazard", "evidence_layer": "source-read", "confidence": "high"}]
